baseline_note: No real lender baseline was provided.  The comparison uses a synthetic Gaussian-perturbed proxy (seed=42) and must not be presented as a real lender or bank benchmark.

latency_metrics.latency_measurement_method: time.perf_counter() over 5 full scoring passes on 2415 rows (1 warm-up pass discarded). Covers: feature-matrix build, XGBClassifier.predict_proba, Platt-calibrator.predict_proba, per-row TreeSHAP explain(), risk-band classification, and score-mapping. Excludes: model load from disk and CSV I/O.
